subject: Azure Private Offer: marketplace listing controls, revenue recognition & invoice flow
messages:
From: Stephanie Holmes <procurement@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: azure-marketplace@partner.microsoft.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure private offer listing — initial governance & invoice questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement at BrightPath is trying to close the PO for the Azure private plan (PO attached for background). Before we can approve, we need a couple of clarifications about how the Azure private offer will appear in the Marketplace and the downstream finance flow: 

- Who will be the seller/merchant of record on the Marketplace listing (Redwood or Microsoft)?
- If Redwood is seller of record, can you confirm invoice flow (will Azure bill BrightPath or will Redwood issue invoices)?
- Does the private offer support co-sell designation today? If so, how will partner revenue share be invoiced/credited?
- Procurement also needs a written revenue-recognition statement (simple one paragraph) for internal auditors and SOC2 evidence for data handling.

I've attached our RFP and a stub PO (BrightPath_PO_4853.pdf). Can you share the relevant legal/commercial docs and a short diagram of the invoice flow? If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute sync next week.

Thanks,
Stephanie Holmes
Procurement Manager
BrightPath Health

Attachment: BP_RFP_2027.pdf
Attachment: BrightPath_PO_4853.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Holmes <procurement@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure private offer listing — initial governance & invoice questions

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, and attaching the requested artifacts so your team can circulate them: Azure_PrivateOffer_Terms.docx and a one-page invoice/workflow diagram (Azure_Marketplace_Workflow.pdf).

Summary (short):
- Merchant of record: Redwood typically operates two supported flows for private offers on Azure:
  1) Marketplace-billed: Microsoft invoices the customer (Azure as M.O.R.), and Microsoft remits to Redwood per marketplace payout terms. This is simpler for customers but shifts some timing for revenue recognition.
  2) Redwood-billed: Redwood is merchant of record and invoices BrightPath directly (Redwood issues invoices; customer pays Redwood). This is supported for enterprise private offers with a commercial agreement.

- Co-sell: We can enable co-sell designation on the listing; revenue share treatment depends on whether the transaction uses marketplace billing vs. Redwood billing. For marketplace-billed deals, revenue share is handled via Microsoft payouts; for Redwood-billed deals we will include a partner crediting statement in the SOW and settle via Redwood finance.

- Revenue recognition statement (requested): "Revenue for services sold via Azure private offers will be recognized by Redwood Inference upon customer acceptance of provisioning and invoice issuance, in accordance with Redwood's revenue recognition policy. If Microsoft invoices the customer, Redwood recognizes revenue upon receipt of payout from Microsoft adjusted for Marketplace fees and any deferred performance obligations." (We can refine wording with your accounting team.)

Next steps: please confirm which invoice path your CFO prefers (Marketplace-billed vs Redwood-billed). If Redwood-billed is required, we'll surface the standard invoice terms and tax details and route a DocuSign-ready agreement.

Call? I can do a 30-minute slot Mon 6/14 9–10am PT or Tue 6/15 1–3pm PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Azure_PrivateOffer_Terms.docx, Azure_Marketplace_Workflow.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Holmes <procurement@brightpathhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure private offer listing — initial governance & invoice questions

Stephanie / Marissa — following up from Marissa's note with the commercial redlines. Key legal points we've captured in the attached redlines file (redlines_Azure_Terms.docx):

- Indemnity: we propose mutual limited indemnities with carve-outs for gross negligence and will limit aggregate liability to the fees paid in the prior 12 months.
- Data residency: Redwood can commit to processing BrightPath customer data in the US only for this private offer; we will provide SOC2 attestation (attached).
- Audit & evidence: procurement asked for evidence — included reference to our SOC2 PDF and standard security addendum.

If BrightPath prefers Redwood-billed flow we will swap to our standard MSA exhibit and DocuSign template. Otherwise, if Marketplace-billed is chosen we will add language that clarifies timing of revenue recognition and Microsoft payout terms.

I'll prepare the DocuSign routing once we get confirmation on invoice flow and any specific PO/contract language BrightPath's legal wants changed.

Regards,
Markus Klein
VP Legal, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlines_Azure_Terms.docx

From: Stephanie Holmes <procurement@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure private offer listing — initial governance & invoice questions

Marissa / Markus,

Thanks — that helps a lot. BrightPath Procurement has reviewed the attached terms and prefers the Marketplace-billed route (Microsoft invoices BrightPath). Procurement requires two things to close: 1) an explicit sentence in the agreement documenting that Microsoft is the billing entity and outlining expected payout timing to Redwood, and 2) SOC2 evidence that covers data handling for the service. We have an internal control asking for the revenue recognition note as well (your short paragraph is fine).

I've attached the formal PO for our records (BrightPath_PO_4853.pdf). Our legal team has a short comment on the indemnity cap — I'll loop in counsel if redlines are needed.

Can you send the DocuSign link with the final private-offer addendum and attach SOC2 attestation? Our finance team will route the PO once DocuSign is complete.

Regards,
Stephanie Holmes
Procurement Manager
BrightPath Health

Attachment: BrightPath_PO_4853.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Holmes <procurement@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure private offer listing — initial governance & invoice questions

Stephanie — great, thanks for confirming the Marketplace-billed path. Per your request we have: 

- Inserted an explicit sentence in the private-offer addendum that: "Microsoft will be the billing entity for Azure Marketplace private offers; payouts to Redwood are subject to Microsoft Marketplace payout schedules and fees."
- Attached SOC2 attestation (SOC2_attestation.pdf) and our Statement of Work (BP_SOW_v1.pdf) for the provisioning milestone.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcd-efgh-4853 (DocuSign routing: Stephanie -> BrightPath legal -> BrightPath finance -> Redwood countersign).

Ben (cc'd) from Finance: can you confirm the expected payout timing and whether Redwood needs any additional billing metadata to reconcile Microsoft marketplace payouts to the BrightPath PO?

Proposed closing timeline: once DocuSign is signed (we've prefilled the addendum), BrightPath finance will approve the PO and Microsoft will schedule provisioning via the marketplace onboarding flow (we'll confirm provisioning ETA in the post-sign onboarding call).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BP_SOW_v1.pdf, SOC2_attestation.pdf
